title: Byte Engine prefab
description: A reusable group of entities with parameters, consumed by the .prefab asset handler.

parameters.description: Parameter names and their default values, which an instance or the spawning code can replace.

entities.description: The entities of the prefab, in any order. Payloads can refer to a parameter with { "$parameter": name }.

id.description: A name, unique in the file, that other entities use to refer to this one.

parent.description: The id of the entity this one belongs to. Without one, it belongs to the instance.

components.description: The entity's components, from kind name to payload, as in a level. Any value can be a parameter reference.
